column1: # Smoke X parser vectors - machine-readable validation corpus.
#   category   x4 | x2-defensive | malformed | foreign-id | detached |
#              ok-out-of-band means a parser may decode the sync, but the
#              caller must reject the frequency before retuning or ACKing.
#   device_id  expected parsed ID, or - when not asserted
#   units      F | C | - (wire value 1 is F; anything else is C)
#   attached   bit string for probes, LSB = probe 1, or -
#   frequency  expected sync frequency in Hz, or -
#   payload    the exact ASCII air payload, including the trailing comma
# X2-era rows are defensive only: they do not define product behaviour.
# Real X4 rows are transcribed from protocol/fixtures/lora/*.loralog.
# The parser/caller split for out-of-band sync is design 02 sections 2.3/2.7.
